```sh
kafka admin call <method>
```

Call any Admin method by name — the escape hatch for everything without its own command _(unstable)_

## Arguments

| Argument | Description                        |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `method` | Admin method name, e.g. listTopics |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

The selected method determines arguments, return shape, compatibility, and mutation behavior. This is an unstable passthrough. The output example illustrates listTopics; other methods return their own shapes.

## Before you run

May mutate broker state depending on the method. Inspect admin methods classification and the Admin reference before invoking an unfamiliar method.

## Flags

| Flag                   | Description                                                           |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`   | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                      |
| `--from-file <string>` | path to a JSON file with the method arguments                         |
| `--yes`                | confirm a non-read-only method                                        |
| `--force`              | confirm a non-read-only method (required alongside --yes)             |
| `--show-secrets`       | print credential fields (password, hmac, …) instead of redacting them |

## Examples

```sh
kafka admin call listTopics --brokers localhost:9092
kafka admin call createAcls --from-file ./acls.json --yes --force
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
["events"]
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
